findings.source_evidence: The source describes cellwise modification by edge fluxes.

rationale: The core definition has the correct conservative sign and indexing: cell i is updated by subtracting fluxScale times its right edge flux minus its left edge flux. Finset.range and sum then give the exact boundary-only telescoping law, including the empty block. With exact physical edge flux explicitly assumed, the target faithfully realizes the scoped finite-volume principle and adds a genuine conservative block-balance theorem, so it is accepted as faithful-stronger.
